name: Lastwall Phalanx
text:
**Lastwall Phalanx** (Teamwork)

When battling the terrifying hordes of Belkzen, you find
 strength in your shield brothers and sisters.

**Prerequisites**: Base attack bonus +3, good alignment.

**Benefit**: You gain a sacred bonus to your AC against
 the attacks of evil creatures and a sacred bonus to saves
 against the spells and abilities of evil creatures equal to
 the number of adjacent allies who also have this feat.
